indep-000.label: Peter Lombard
indep-000.summary: A scholar who taught at pre-university Bologna and Paris and wrote the Sentences and biblical glosses, compared in a story seed to the works of a Hermetic writer.

indep-001.label: Diseased Possession
indep-001.summary: An infernal power, a variety of Possession, by which a demon enters a victim and spends Might to inflict a disease's contagion.

indep-002.label: Madrasah
indep-002.summary: An Islamic higher-education school attached to a mosque and run by religious leaders, privately endowed and supported by student tuition.

indep-003.label: Alchemical Steel
indep-003.summary: A Level 20 Alteration Reagent producing a purified, harder form of iron; blades made of it gain +2 damage and armor gains +2 Protection.

indep-004.label: Cautious with Chirurgy
indep-004.summary: A Virtue commonly taken by empirici that reduces botch risk when using the Chirurgy Ability.

indep-005.label: Poor Disputer
indep-005.summary: A Minor General Flaw causing a character to suffer a -3 penalty on disputatio die rolls.

indep-006.label: Sons of the Peters
indep-006.summary: A small, argumentative group of northern speculative grammarians basing their method on Peter Helias and Peter of Spain; secretly aided in their disputationes by demonic tempters granting an Infernally tainted Puissant Artes Liberales.

indep-007.label: Medicus
indep-007.summary: A general term for a practitioner who may perform medicine or surgery but has no formal claim to the higher title of doctor; the majority of practicing physicians.

indep-008.label: The Key of Theodorus
indep-008.summary: A ReTe 5 Hermetic spell (R: Touch, D: Mom, T: Part) that magically opens any single lock regardless of complexity, named for Theodorus of Samos.

indep-009.label: Puissant Swordsmith
indep-009.summary: A Virtue providing a bonus to the Swordsmith Craft Ability, held by the example craftsman Klaus.

indep-010.label: Hospitaller Knights of St. John
indep-010.summary: A military order present in Acre that controls its own section of the city.

indep-011.label: Faerie Tarantula
indep-011.summary: A faerie creature whose bite afflicts victims with tarantism, an excess of yellow bile causing an irresistible urge to dance.

indep-012.label: Charlemagne's Loaf
indep-012.summary: A wondrous loaf of bread whose smallest nibble grants the eater incredible courage, giving a +3 on all Bravery rolls (Craft Level 17).

indep-013.label: St. Crispianian
indep-013.summary: Patron saint of leatherworkers and cobblers (with St. Crispin); brother of St. Crispin who preached in Gaul.

indep-014.label: Writ of Reprisal
indep-014.summary: A court order allowing a wronged merchant to seize goods from any merchant of a fraudster's home town; such a writ against the Order could trigger Quaesitor review of a covenant's representatives.

indep-015.label: Lorris
indep-015.summary: A small town in France first granted customary rights by King Louis VI, later confirmed by Louis VII in 1155, whose generous customs included freeman status after a year and a day.

indep-016.label: Excessive Lighting
indep-016.summary: A Minor laboratory Outfittings Virtue: the lab is lit far more than necessary with hundreds of candles or lamps (+2 Upkeep, +2 Imaginem).

indep-017.label: Lousy Ingredients
indep-017.summary: A Free laboratory Outfittings Flaw: the lab is supplied with dirty, impure, or poor-quality ingredients (-1 General Quality, -1 Upkeep).

indep-018.label: The Marvelous Hound
indep-018.summary: A Muto Animal (Corpus, Mentem) 34 enchanted collar that transforms a normal hound into an erect, handed servant with a grog's intellect while retaining hound loyalty.

indep-019.label: The (Over) Familiar Cat
indep-019.summary: A magical familiar cat with Magic Might 10 (Imaginem) bonded to a magus, with powers of night-vision and invisible movement and shared-senses bond effects.

indep-020.label: Craft: Percamenarius
indep-020.summary: The craft of making parchment; a Perception + Finesse roll substitutes for it to determine the quality of vellum produced by the spell Hide to Parchment.

indep-021.label: Covenant of the Redbreasted Warriors
indep-021.summary: A fallen covenant whose aura a faerie king is said to hold captive in a wine bottle.

indep-022.label: Ward Against Flame
indep-022.summary: A Rego Ignem 15 spell creating a circle that mundane fires cannot cross, used around heat sources, grain stores, and sometimes whole laboratories.

indep-023.label: Realia
indep-023.summary: Collections of mundane or magical objects (preserved animals, minerals, gemstones, bones) that magi study as a tractatus and use as clues for Intellego magic.

indep-024.label: Aedes Mercurii
indep-024.summary: A powerful covenant in the Provençal Tribunal with two sites, one centered on a majestic stone edifice known as the Temple (Templum) and another carved out of the Pic du Midi d'Ossau.

indep-025.label: Magians
indep-025.summary: The original priestly caste of Persia, of which the Median tribe of Magians were the true blood ancestors granting the Magian Lineage Virtue.

indep-026.label: Mateos, the Faerie Butler
indep-026.summary: A child-sized faerie (Might 10, Herbam) who lives for drunken parties, serving intoxicating drinks from an endless barrel and encouraging people to embarrass themselves.

indep-027.label: Phantasmal Fire
indep-027.summary: A Creo Imaginem spell with an Ignem requisite that makes an image of a fire that dances, illuminates, crackles, and apparently warms but does not actually burn; popular at gatherings of House Flambeau.

indep-028.label: Animal Ken (Ability)
indep-028.summary: The Supernatural Ability to communicate with animals, conferred by the Animal Ken Virtue at score 1.

indep-029.label: Kassalan Dust
indep-029.summary: A dust of powdered gold, myrrh, and spices made by the Mortuary Society of Kassala, required for Kassalan Exorcism and granting a +3 Shape & Material bonus against the dead.

indep-030.label: Uncertain Faith
indep-030.summary: A Minor General Flaw in which doubt stands between the character and the Divine, giving -3 to holy influence rolls and a +1 Personality Trait that demons exploit.

indep-031.label: Immunity to Cold
indep-031.summary: A Minor, Supernatural Virtue making normal cold harmless to the character, though extreme magical cold still affects him.

indep-032.label: Henry the Fowler
indep-032.summary: Duke of the Saxons who received the German crown in 919 and defeated the Magyar hordes at Riade in 933.

indep-033.label: Slave-Owner
indep-033.summary: A new Minor General Virtue making a character the legal owner of one (largely unskilled) slave, lost if the slave is freed or killed.

indep-034.label: Rübezahl
indep-034.summary: A Waldgeist who haunts the forests of the Riesengebirge (Giant Mountains).

indep-035.label: Durenmar Lore
indep-035.summary: An Ability reflecting a magus' familiarity with the contents of the Great Library, addable to study rolls there with a cumulative penalty.

indep-036.label: The God of Truth
indep-036.summary: The creator deity of a new dualist faith in the villages near the Bohemian Forest, said to be immaterial and found only in wild places, opposed to the God of Law; his angels are said to be faeries, and his prophet is Iacob.

indep-037.label: Nebelkönigin
indep-037.summary: A magically enhanced ship, pride of Waddenzee's pirate fleet, stolen from Oculus Septentrionalis (built by the Verditius shipwright Marcus) while it carried vis and magical books.

indep-038.label: Linden Gild
indep-038.summary: A peace-striving go-between gild founded by former magi of Fengheld after the Schism War, seeking cooperation between magi and covenants; led by Occultes of Durenmar.

indep-039.label: The Magic Fountain
indep-039.summary: A spring near the Brocken that grants visions to those who drink from it.

indep-040.label: Enchanted birthing chair
indep-040.summary: An enchanted chair at Voluntas's village that ensures almost all mothers and children survive childbirth, giving Wilton unusually high life expectancy.

indep-041.label: Tribunal Summons
indep-041.summary: A formal summons to a Hermetic tribunal that Redcaps must deliver at least six months before the tribunal takes place; rigorously enforced.

indep-042.label: Maiden Castle
indep-042.summary: A large set of hilltop earthworks south of Dorchester in Dorset, seemingly deserted but said in local tales to be a faerie stronghold where the fay may be met on the correct night.

indep-043.label: King's Bench
indep-043.summary: One of the highest English courts of appeal, fixed at Westminster by Magna Carta, trying important civil and treason cases and issuing writs; its senior justice is Martin of Pattishall.

indep-044.label: Huarwar
indep-044.summary: A Welsh faerie who helped complete Offa's Dyke in 787 in exchange for cattle; now eats parts of the dyke and villages when not paid.

indep-045.label: Roma Nova
indep-045.summary: A covenant of traditionalist Latin magi founded in Kent in 946, unpopular with Bjornaer, Díedne, and Ex Miscellanea; destroyed by the Díedne in 1008.

indep-046.label: St. Erkenwald
indep-046.summary: A seventh-century bishop of London and patron saint of the city; the blasphemer Eustace who mocked his shrine was struck down by divine judgment.

indep-047.label: Gwenn (the white mantle)
indep-047.summary: King Arthur's white mantle in the Dream of Rhonabwy; anyone wrapped in it can see everyone while remaining invisible.

indep-048.label: Torture Chair of Zeus
indep-048.summary: A mechanized chair Hephaestus made that Zeus used to torture Hera; rediscovered by Milo and prize of the first Verditius Contest, won by Gelon.

indep-049.label: The Edges of the World
indep-049.summary: Four regiones corresponding to the four elements and humors to which a spirit-traveling Criamon magus is sequentially drawn, and from which he must escape back to his body.

indep-050.label: Form of the (Temperament) Heartbeast
indep-050.summary: A Muto Animal 20 spell with four temperament versions (sanguine, choleric, melancholic, phlegmatic) that enhances an animal form's humoral correspondences; modeled from Birna's innate abilities.

indep-051.label: Brittle Bones
indep-051.summary: A Major Curse (Rego Corpus effect) making the victim's bones fragile, risking broken bones (treated as Heavy Wounds) during strenuous activity.

indep-052.label: Roscius
indep-052.summary: Filius of Verditius who stole the sword Durendal and took it to Verdi; by studying it he and his filii became famous makers of magical swords, founding the Confraternity of Roland.

indep-053.label: Ceres
indep-053.summary: A goddess one of whose priestesses always serves as a hierophant of the Huntress in the Wood.

indep-054.label: Craft Automata
indep-054.summary: A Major Hermetic Virtue and Ability (initial score 1) granted by the Automata Mystery, allowing a character to construct mechanical men and beasts.

indep-055.label: Huntress in the Wood Lore
indep-055.summary: The Ability required to Initiate the grades of the Huntress in the Wood cult, with set thresholds for advancing from kerykes to eumolpids.

indep-056.label: House Tytalus Lore
indep-056.summary: A Hermetic lore Ability concerning the history and customs of House Tytalus, exemplified by the Analects of Tytalus summa.

indep-057.label: Restriction (True Feeling)
indep-057.summary: A Major Hermetic Flaw of the Cult of Orpheus.

indep-058.label: Green Dragon of Labin
indep-058.summary: A dragon famously slain by the Flambeau magus Vilano, who crushed it with two falling trees using only indirect spells.

indep-060.label: Horn of the Champions
indep-060.summary: An invested magical horn kept at Castra Solis that can alert and instantly summon senior Flambeau magi from anywhere in Mythic Europe via Arcane Connections.

indep-061.label: Enchantment of the Pedestrian Pigeon
indep-061.summary: A MuMe 15 spell that occludes a person's memory of told information until a key phrase unlocks it, used for secure transfer of information between conspirators.

indep-062.label: First Singer
indep-062.summary: A leadership title of the Seirenes won at a grand competition every 12 years, hosting the next competition at her covenant.

indep-063.label: Major Magical Focus in Spirits
indep-063.summary: A Major Magical Focus developed by Titanoi magi during apprenticeship, applying to all supernatural entities with a naturally insubstantial form including ghosts.

indep-064.label: Mythic Cathay
indep-064.summary: Distant land to which emissaries went.

indep-065.label: Dacians
indep-065.summary: People who ruled Transylvania before the Romans, fighting under wolf-headed dragon banners.

indep-066.label: Heroic Personality
indep-066.summary: Minor Heroic Flaw granting strong Personality traits and Confidence, but letting the storyguide sometimes dictate the character's heroic actions.

indep-067.label: Pluto
indep-067.summary: God of the Underworld and hidden wealth whom Tremere's ancestors served, symbolized by the two-pronged pitchfork.

indep-068.label: Common White Wolves
indep-068.summary: Magical wolves descended from Tremere's familiar, serving the House.

indep-069.label: The Whole from the Part
indep-069.summary: InCo 20 spell giving a mental image of a person's essential nature via an Arcane Connection.

indep-070.label: Roman Army Lore
indep-070.summary: Ability referenced as used or valued by Tremere magi or creatures.

indep-071.label: Skull of Guorna the Fetid
indep-071.summary: Relic sought by necromancers to learn Guorna's techniques.

indep-072.label: Toframenn
indep-072.summary: Icelandic term for the magi of Vindolanda.

indep-073.label: Landvaettir lords
indep-073.summary: Powerful landvaettir who held the galdramen leader in esteem and give attendant spirits to all galdramen during the conflict.

indep-075.label: Landvaettir bargains
indep-075.summary: Deals galdramen make with spirits that can give magic resistance.

indep-076.label: Spirit bottle
indep-076.summary: Device Albinus uses to capture Vindsvall.

indep-077.label: Kill the Living Air
indep-077.summary: Spell cast spontaneously with vis that badly drains Vindsvall's Might.

indep-078.label: War Tribunal
indep-078.summary: Special Tribunal called by Lavinia at Durenmar in 1230 to organize the Hermetic Crusade, declaring all Icelandic magicians enemies of the Order.

indep-079.label: Scartaris
indep-079.summary: Vindolanda's Icelandic complex and sanctum beneath glacial ice, target of Julius's assault.

indep-081.label: Clan Mac Donald
indep-081.summary: Highland clan used as an example; its chief is called 'the Mac Donald'.

indep-082.label: Robes of Puissant Might
indep-082.summary: Caitlin's protection 15 robes with no encumbrance.

indep-083.label: John Comyn
indep-083.summary: Leader who rivals Robert the Bruce and attacks him in Selkirk forest in 1299.

indep-084.label: Trained as a Gruagach
indep-084.summary: -4 Hermetic Flaw: mistakenly trained as a gruagach for a year, giving -1 to Parma Magica and Art scores.

indep-085.label: Highland Giants
indep-085.summary: Nearly extinct race of giants in Sutherland and Strathnavar, in two kinds.

indep-087.label: Loch Oadh
indep-087.summary: Loch where Damhan-allaidh ambushed Pralix in 814.

indep-089.label: Knightly Demands
indep-089.summary: Optional Major Story Flaw that replaces Oath of Fealty. The storyguide can use it to pull knights into ballad-style plots such as quests, feuds and rescues.

indep-090.label: Noble Reputation
indep-090.summary: A fourth style of Reputation alongside Local, Hermetic, and Ecclesiastic, allowing members of the landed class to know about each other.

indep-091.label: Ricohombre
indep-091.summary: Iberian great men of the aristocratic upper class who hold honores from kings. They have the Great Noble Virtue.

indep-092.label: Castro Selvaggio
indep-092.summary: Covenant castle whose magi created siege spells when besieged by a Milanese force; it was eventually sacked.

indep-093.label: Falcon of Virtue
indep-093.summary: Rare falcon with burning feathers sought as a tournament prize in a story seed.

indep-094.label: Seal the Breach
indep-094.summary: CrTe 20 ritual conjuring a section of wall that knits with existing fortifications, restoring up to five damage levels.

indep-095.label: Phillip Augustus
indep-095.summary: The current king of France, the first of his dynasty not to have his heir acclaimed while he lives.

indep-096.label: Son of Merchant
indep-096.summary: Social Status Virtue of the Merchant's Son.

indep-097.label: Dependence
indep-097.summary: Minor Child Personality Flaw: uncomfortable without a trusted mentor, -3 when alone.

indep-098.label: Bellum
indep-098.summary: A game invented by Casius in the 10th century where apprentices duel with illusionary Roman soldiers via Ager Belli.

indep-099.label: Infernal Hawk
indep-099.summary: Infernal bird in a story seed that follows grogs hoping to snatch a Gifted baby.

indep-100.label: Urchin
indep-100.summary: Sample eleven-year-old grog, daughter of a branded outlaw living on city streets who aims to lead a gang of child thieves.

indep-101.label: Polyaigos
indep-101.summary: Island covenant in the Theban Tribunal running a school for Gifted children.

indep-102.label: The Book of Nimiane
indep-102.summary: The legendary journal in which Nimiane recorded Merlin's secrets and three great names; sought in the Stonehenge and Normandy Tribunals.

indep-103.label: Gifted Lab Assistant
indep-103.summary: A Gifted child kept as a lab helper without having her Arts Opened; most Tribunals declare this practice a low crime.

indep-105.label: Witches of Reims
indep-105.summary: A folk witch coven in and around Reims, several of whose witches were burned by Archbishop William in the late 12th century.

indep-106.label: Heriodas
indep-106.summary: Faerie leader of processions of the dead, collecting the dead and leading them to pagan underworlds.

indep-107.label: Borrow the Wings of the Eagle
aliases: Borrow the Wings of the Eagle
indep-107.summary: GvSh 10 spell turning the caster's arms into giant wings allowing flight as fast as a galloping horse.

indep-108.label: Half Taltós
indep-108.summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue of a failed taltós candidate, granting limited Second Sight and spirit-harming weapons.

indep-109.label: Domhnall the Gruagach Master
indep-109.summary: Gifted gruagach master from a Scottish highland village, a large cudgel-wielding man who fought the English and seeks to rebuild a collective.

indep-110.label: Anne's House
indep-110.summary: Manor a few miles from Kilkenny with a lab outbuilding and a bog where a dying giant is pinned.

indep-111.label: Aesc
indep-111.summary: Additional Anglo-Saxon Futhorc rune meaning "Ash", with no Elder Futhark equivalent.

indep-112.label: Wand of Dancing Flowers
indep-112.summary: Magical toy sold at the faerie toy market.

indep-113.label: Field of Hooks
indep-113.summary: Field of Purgatory where perpetrators of fraud hang from hooks over flames.

indep-114.label: Histria
indep-114.summary: Oppidum on the Istrian Peninsula in the Transylvanian Tribunal.

indep-115.label: Blessing of Mercury
indep-115.summary: CrVi 30 ritual granting +3 to Casting and Laboratory totals for a Year.

indep-116.label: Creature of Virtue
indep-116.summary: Magic animals such as Ravens, Stags, Hares and Mice of Virtue that inhabit the truffle regio.

indep-117.label: Leda
indep-117.summary: Julia's twin sister, abducted by faeries at age five.

indep-118.label: Enter the Sylvan Glen
indep-118.summary: Daktyl power to enter any Faerie regio.

indep-119.label: Puissant Carouse
indep-119.summary: Virtue or creature Quality listed for a being (Anne, Minerva Sulis, Balneator) or setting feature described here.

indep-121.label: The Soul in the Egg
indep-121.summary: Further idea for a prop story element.

indep-122.label: Borrowers
indep-122.summary: Exotic traveling faerie wizards practicing the Ars Fabulosa who trade novel goods to faeries for blessings.

indep-123.label: The Forbidden Chamber
indep-123.summary: Scenery story element: a room in a castle everyone is forbidden to enter, testing curiosity against obedience.

indep-124.label: Birthing Faerie
indep-124.summary: Threshold faerie attracted by a pregnant mother.

indep-125.label: Touch of the Merciless Lover
indep-125.summary: Empathy/Woe 25 rite making the target waste away and die until the duration ends.

indep-126.label: Faerie Antipathy
indep-126.summary: Major or Minor Supernatural Flaw giving a negative Sympathy Trait.

indep-127.label: Touch of Faerie
indep-127.summary: Condition gained by children who survive being stolen or raised by faeries.

indep-128.label: Acclimation Prone
indep-128.summary: Major Inferiority doubling difficulty of avoiding Acclimation.

indep-129.label: Aura Strengthening Table
indep-129.summary: Table rolled when the yearly aura modifier is +4 or more, with outcomes from new regio levels to permanent aura increase.

indep-131.label: Locus of the Literatus
indep-131.summary: CrIm 20 Ritual that draws the caster's location as a vestige in a book, producing a map for travel in the Magic Realm.

indep-132.label: Ash Branch of Muto Vis
indep-132.summary: Ash-branch vis granting Reserves of Strength and Toughness in battle.

indep-133.label: Broken Branches
indep-133.summary: A group of Redcaps united by love of nature, founded by a Loamwalker.

indep-134.label: Transformed Humans
indep-134.summary: Humans transformed by magic into beings of the Magic Realm, losing their humanity.

indep-135.label: Barcas
indep-135.summary: Example magical giant (Might 16 Terram), a boastful wrestler nearly invulnerable to metal except for a spot below his sternum; based on Ferragus.

indep-136.label: Philosophic Magic
indep-136.summary: Minor Supernatural Virtue adding Philosophiae to Kabbalah totals.

indep-137.label: Orthodox Church Lore
indep-137.summary: Lore Ability of the Byzantine Priest.

indep-138.label: Tree Guarded by Michael
indep-138.summary: Sample Empyreal aura: a sacred tree from Eden (Divine Might 50) on a mountain, likely in the Caucasus, radiating aura 5; its seedlings' fruit grants Joyful and slows aging.

indep-139.label: Book of Solomon
indep-139.summary: Book whose copies teach the Notory Art.

indep-140.label: Non-traditional
indep-140.summary: Minor Supernatural Flaw: belonging to no holy tradition, with no favored Abilities; requires True Faith.

indep-141.label: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word
aliases: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word
indep-141.summary: Invocation Wonders effect (Level 35) summoning and controlling a powerful force of nature.

indep-142.label: Sunnis
indep-142.summary: Mainstream Muslims whose doctrines follow al-Ash'ari and al-Maturidi; they recognize the caliph in Baghdad.

indep-144.label: Corrupted (Ability)
indep-144.summary: Flaw granted by the Watchers' Corrupted Knowledge Power, rewarding selfish or sinful use of the Ability.

indep-145.label: Blight the Household
indep-145.summary: Fictiles Power spoiling food and blighting crops.

indep-147.label: Berith the Ennobler
indep-147.summary: A Spirit of Deceit appearing as a red-clad crowned soldier on a red horse, who makes things seem nobler than they are and produces unworthy noblemen; popular with alchemists.

indep-148.label: Ophites
indep-148.summary: Gnostic sect that worships the serpent of paradise as the symbol of God and revels in original sin.

indep-149.label: Command the Vile Spirit
indep-149.summary: ReVi 20 forcing a demon to obey.

indep-150.label: Rudolphus of House Bonisagus
indep-150.summary: One of the most infamous Venatores, Wizard's Marched in 1151 A.D. for persecuting demons so much that they turned their wrath on the Order.

indep-151.label: Good Characteristics
indep-151.summary: Virtue for points spent on Characteristics.

indep-152.label: Belaquin
indep-152.summary: Covenant in Provence whose grog sold Angela a club of faerie-forest wood.

indep-153.label: Exceptional Strength
indep-153.summary: Virtue named in the text, associated with Larta chefs, smiths, minstrels or muses.

indep-154.label: Speak Romansch
indep-154.summary: Ability listed in the Alpine redcap template or Hera's statistics.

indep-155.label: Antares
indep-155.summary: Rumored supreme war leader appointed by the Council of Archmagi, named for a great ruby badge of office.

indep-156.label: Cubic Fluorite
indep-156.summary: Cubic Fluorite listed in the Tribunal index among minerals and substances.

indep-157.label: Lucent Faeries
indep-157.summary: Moon faeries of great interest to Alpine magi.

indep-158.label: Rauhnachte
indep-158.summary: Austrian festival in late October when some animals gain speech and powers; celebrated by familiars.

indep-159.label: Vervay
indep-159.summary: Center of the Abbaye des Vignerons.

indep-160.label: Organization Lore: Knights Templar
indep-160.summary: Knowledge of Templar rule, members, provinces, sign language and ciphers.

indep-161.label: New Temple
indep-161.summary: Templar chapterhouse in London on the Thames, seat of the English Master.

indep-163.label: Patarus
indep-163.summary: Demon of the Order of Accusers serving BaalBaruth, who appears as a thin horned monk in Cluniac garb and uses powers like Whispers Behind the Back.

indep-164.label: A Commentary on Isaiah and Jeremiah
aliases: A Commentary on Isaiah and Jeremiah

indep-165.label: Acolyte
indep-165.summary: Greatest of the minor orders, symbolized by an extinguished candlestick and empty vessel; often parish clerks, scribes, or messengers.

indep-166.label: The Great Discord
indep-166.summary: CrVi 55 Ritual that taints a parish so everyone suffers The Gift's social penalties for a Moon.

indep-167.label: John of Capella
indep-167.summary: Early follower of Francis who, while Francis was away, gathered lepers and began to develop a new religious order for them.

indep-168.label: Britannian Tribunal
indep-168.summary: Original Tribunal that initially included Brittany; later divided into the Stonehenge, Loch Leglean, and Hibernian Tribunals.

indep-169.label: Fool's Cap Bell
indep-169.summary: Proctor's talisman, a brass bell enchanted against Infernal influence.

indep-170.label: Normandy Lore
indep-170.summary: Ability appearing in character or creature statistics in this text.

indep-172.label: Korrigan
indep-172.summary: Breton faeries: hunchbacked manikins with cat's claws and goat's hooves who dance and may take the form of a beautiful woman; dangerous in Brocéliande.

indep-173.label: Aura of Enobled Presence
indep-173.summary: Effect wrongly believed bestowed permanently by the Holy Oil.

indep-174.label: Puissant Bows
indep-174.summary: Virtue boosting the Bows ability; held by Baudouin.

indep-175.label: Blood Haze
indep-175.summary: Minor Hermetic Flaw: the maga is crazed by bloodshed, penalizing Formulaic magic and Concentration in combat.

indep-176.label: Mathematikoi
indep-176.summary: The Inner Order of the Fraternity of Samos, robed in black or white, who abstain from meat and beans and must teach new Initiates.

indep-177.label: Haruspicy
indep-177.summary: Divinatory method using entrails of sacrificed animals, listed among Ceremonial Augury Phenomena.

indep-178.label: Green Stone Lore
indep-178.summary: The cult Lore of the Knights of the Green Stone.

indep-179.label: Caduceus
indep-179.summary: Symbol of Mercury/Hermes: a winged staff with entwined serpents.

indep-181.label: Binding the Immortal Memory
indep-181.summary: CrMe Mystery enchantment that binds studied experience into an immortal's talisman at level 10 x XP.

indep-182.label: Languedoc Tribunal
indep-182.summary: Tribunal where Mathematikoi robes resemble Cathar perfecti.

indep-183.label: Demiurge
